user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.

positive.title: Mark a task as complete successfully
steps: Select a task that is not marked as complete
Click on the 'Mark as complete' button
positive.expected_result: The task is marked as complete and is visually updated in the task list

positive.title: Check progress tracking after marking a task complete
positive.expected_result: The completed task is reflected in the user's progress tracking

negative.title: Attempt to mark a task as complete with no tasks available
steps: Open the task list with no tasks present
Attempt to click on 'Mark as complete' for a non-existent task
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating no tasks are available

negative.title: Mark already completed task as complete
steps: Select a task that is already marked as complete
Click on the 'Mark as complete' button
negative.expected_result: An alert or message is displayed indicating the task is already complete

edge.title: Mark a task as complete with network latency
steps: Select a task and click on 'Mark as complete'
edge.expected_result: The task is marked as complete eventually, but with a noticeable delay and an indication of processing

edge.title: Mark the last task as complete
steps: Open the task list containing only one task
Click on 'Mark as complete' for the last remaining task
edge.expected_result: The task is marked as complete, and the task list shows no tasks remaining
